name: HeroQuest: Digital Edition
storyline:
The sinister forces of dread sorcerer Zargon seek to conquer the Realm. A lone beacon of hope remains: four brave heroes who must stand against the tide of darkness. The Barbarian, the Dwarf, the Elf, and the Wizard have answered the call, and you will lead them to glory.

Unite your fellowship with a party of up to four players through online co-op, or command the heroes yourself as you descend into a treacherous world of the unknown to restore honor to the Realm.

Destroy the forces of Dread with tactical turn-based combat, rolling the dice of fate to decide which path you take! Strategically combine the unique skills of the four brave adventurers to overcome Zargon's challenges.

Position the Barbarian to break through enemy defenses, have the Dwarf search for traps, protect the Wizard as he unleashes arcane power, and task the Elf with landing the final strike. Only through collaboration and teamwork using the entire party can you hope to survive.
summary: Descend into the dungeon to destroy the forces of Dread and protect the Realm in this tactical turn-based RPG based on the timeless tabletop legacy. Form a fellowship of four or set forth on your adventure solo, roll the dice and let the quest begin!
